tools.name: elvanto_list_people
tools.description: List people in the church database, optionally filtered by category and by suspended / contact / archived status. Paginated (the response carries page, per_page, total). Elvanto: people/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_search_people
tools.description: Find people matching field values, e.g. {"email":"john@example.com"} or {"lastname":"Smith","volunteer":"yes"}. Searchable keys: firstname, preferred_name, lastname, email, phone, mobile, category_id, archived, contact, deceased, volunteer, gender, birthday, anniversary, marital_status, school_grade

tools.name: elvanto_get_person
tools.description: Fetch one person by id, optionally with extra fields (birthday, addresses, departments, locations, family, custom fields...). Elvanto: people/getInfo.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_categories
tools.description: List the people categories (e.g. New People, Church Members, Inactive) with their ids. Elvanto: people/categories/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_custom_fields
tools.description: List the church's custom person fields (id, name, type and allowed values). Use the id as custom_<id> in fields / search. Elvanto: people/customFields/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_groups
tools.description: List small groups / ministries with meeting day, time, place and frequency; add fields=["people"] to include members and leaders. Elvanto: groups/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_get_group
tools.description: Fetch one group by id, optionally with its members (fields=["people"]). Elvanto: groups/getInfo.

tools.name: elvanto_list_services
tools.description: List services (upcoming by default). Add fields such as volunteers (the roster), plans (order of service) and songs to answer 'who is serving Sunday?' or 'what are we singing?'. Elvanto: services/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_get_service
tools.description: Fetch one service by id with optional detail: service/rehearsal times, plan (order of service), volunteers roster, songs, files, notes. Elvanto: services/getInfo.

tools.name: elvanto_list_songs
tools.description: List or search the song library by title, artist or lyrics (with CCLI number, categories and locations). Elvanto: songs/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_song_arrangements
tools.description: List the arrangements of one song — sequence, BPM, keys, lyrics and chord chart (optionally transposed). Elvanto: songs/arrangements/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_calendars
tools.description: List the church's calendars with their ids. Elvanto: calendar/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_calendar_events
tools.description: List calendar events between two dates, optionally for specific calendars (use "services" as a calendar to include services). Elvanto: calendar/events/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_flows
tools.description: List people flows — the church's follow-up pipelines (e.g. First Time Guest Follow Up) — with their steps and admins. Elvanto: peopleFlows/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_flow_steps
tools.description: List the steps of one people flow with descriptions, instructions, due rules and admins. Elvanto: peopleFlows/steps/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_people_flow_step_people
tools.description: List the people currently in one people-flow step, with status, due date and assigned admin — e.g. who still needs a follow-up call. Not paginated. Elvanto: peopleFlows/steps/people.

tools.name: elvanto_list_financial_categories
tools.description: List giving / chart-of-accounts categories (funds) with ids; status 1 = active, 0 = archived. Elvanto: financial/categories/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_list_transactions
tools.description: List giving transactions between two dates, optionally for one fund — donor, date, method, batch and per-fund amounts. Read-only: this server never writes financial records. Elvanto: financial/transactions/getAll.

tools.name: elvanto_create_person
tools.description: Add a new person to the church database (e.g. a first-time guest). Returns the new person id and family id. Does not create a login. Elvanto: people/create.

tools.name: elvanto_update_person
tools.description: Edit an existing person's details — name, contact info, category, flags, family, or extra fields. Only the fields you pass change. Cannot touch username, password or login status. Elvanto: people/edit.

tools.name: elvanto_add_person_to_group
tools.description: Add a person to a group, optionally as Leader or Assistant Leader. Undoable by removing them from the group in Elvanto. Elvanto: groups/addPerson.

tools.name: elvanto_add_person_to_flow_step
tools.description: Put a person into a people-flow step (e.g. start a new guest's follow-up), optionally assigning a step admin. Elvanto: peopleFlows/steps/addPerson.

tools.name: elvanto_create_calendar_event
tools.description: Create an event on a calendar, optionally repeating. Times are 24-hour GMT. Use status "draft" to stage it unpublished. Elvanto: calendar/events/create.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "elvanto_update_person" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: elvanto_search_people · Private data: elvanto_list_people, elvanto_search_people, elvanto_get_service, elvanto_list_transactions, elvanto_create_person, elvanto_update_person · Public sink: elvanto_search_people.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: elvanto_search_people · Private data: elvanto_list_people, elvanto_search_people, elvanto_get_service, elvanto_list_transactions, elvanto_create_person, elvanto_update_person · Public sink: elvanto_search_people

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
